properties.name: Eastern Ontario
properties.source: Eastern Ontario (owner, Oct 11: option A, then "the boundary shouldn't be a staircase" — and of two straight lines tried, he liked this one better): everything east of one straight line from the Ottawa River just past the Renfrew/Nipissing corner (-78.45715, 46.35735) south-south-east to Lake Ontario, reaching the shore at the Bay of Quinte by Belleville (about -77.42) and running on to (-77.13682, 43.6) in the lake. So Ottawa, the Ottawa Valley, Kingston, Napanee, Belleville and Prince Edward County. The shape runs on over Quebec, the US and the lake, which it never cuts: only the province's own land (CA-ON) is.
